verses.1: In the name of the Father. The book of the discourse which Peter, the chief of the apostles, spoke to Clement his disciple, concerning what shall come to pass through his mercy and his grace, which shall be in heaven and on earth, for the sake of mercy toward mankind, and for the sake of his love for mankind, for the salvation of the world, even as in the midst of the nature of his Father, the fruit of the kingdom which he established, both; and for the sake of this love, by the command of his Father, he descended in the nature of his Father, and wrought the fruit of praise; and by his establishing, he established the whole world.
